Lemma
[Global Hölder compactness] 1. ch6:6.36\group gt-ch06 If $\Omega $ is a $C^{k,\alpha }$ domain and $S$ is bounded in $C^{k,\alpha }(\bar\Omega )$, then $S$ is precompact in $C^{j,\beta }(\bar\Omega )$ for $j+\beta <k+\alpha $.
Proof

\sketch Combine Arzela–Ascoli with the global interpolation inequality (6.91).

□
